name: Process: blue professional
description: One horizontal flow: six numbered blue circular nodes that fade towards the end, a short hairline between nodes, the step name and a one-sentence note under each, and a reminder at the bottom. A bulleted list would lose seeing the whole line at a glance.

kicker.hint: chapter label top left, e.g. "01 — Why"; numbered automatically by the scaffold when the slides in the story carry a chapter, otherwise left empty

meta.hint: rounded tag top right: audience, phase or occasion, up to 10 characters, filled automatically from the first clause of occasion; leave empty when not needed

title.hint: the slide's claim in one sentence, up to 2 lines and 26 characters; *keyword* marks an emphasis (blue)

subtitle.hint: a one-line lede, up to 50 characters

step-1.hint: step: text is the step name (up to 8 characters per line); as a metric, value is the step name and label a one-sentence note

step-2.hint: same as above; leave empty when not needed (the node and its connector disappear together)

step-3.hint: same as above; leave empty when not needed (the node and its connector disappear together)

step-4.hint: same as above; leave empty when not needed (the node and its connector disappear together)

step-5.hint: same as above; leave empty when not needed (the node and its connector disappear together)

step-6.hint: same as above; leave empty when not needed (the node and its connector disappear together)

caption.hint: a reminder for the process: the one or two things most easily missed

title.value: Six fixed steps a quarter, stop and resume at will

subtitle.value: Every step has an output; skip one and the next cannot start.

step-6.label: Write the results into next quarter

caption.value: Verification is missed most often: a fix that is not re-measured is no fix.
